<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**5** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `objectName (symbol, 57 pages)`
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **171** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 157051ceb48d2d9ed289f21f7018a39ce7249178` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `16eb596f988d5db596453086cf6a039dcef5e2d6` — the merge of head `7b18b05f2a164f960e271627658f3bd47411aafd` into base `157051ceb48d2d9ed289f21f7018a39ce7249178`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 16eb596f988d5db596453086cf6a039dcef5e2d6 && git checkout 16eb596f988d5db596453086cf6a039dcef5e2d6
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 157051ceb48d2d9ed289f21f7018a39ce7249178 7b18b05f2a164f960e271627658f3bd47411aafd && git checkout -B drift-repro 157051ceb48d2d9ed289f21f7018a39ce7249178 && git merge --no-ff 7b18b05f2a164f960e271627658f3bd47411aafd

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 157051ceb48d2d9ed289f21f7018a39ce7249178
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7b18b05f2a164f960e271627658f3bd47411aafd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, `packages/lint/src/stored-expression-inputs.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-computed-field-expression-judged.ts`, plus both changesets (prose, judged for the deliberate correction) + read at head: `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`, `stored-expression-inputs.ts`, `authoring-rules.ts`, `runtime-gate.ts`, `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/artifact-packages.ts`, `stack-collections.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/{types.ts,migrations.test.ts}`

Check-runs at review time: `Check Changeset` failure (the declared DELIBERATE CORRECTION refusal on `.changeset/32529-…`, nothing else in its log); 18 in progress; the rest success or skipped. Tests and type check are not yet a gate verdict. `main` moved `c54a23d2` → `157051ce` with no change to any path of this diff.

### ① Derived judgments

- Declared target: each field each kept `objectExtensionsByTarget` entry adds is judged by `judgeFieldFormula` against `fieldIndex`/`fieldTypeIndex` (built over `objectsAsServed`), with `fieldDefs` built as the object walk builds its own. No second fold. **Right.**
- Undeclared target: `fields`/`fieldTypes` undefined, so existence, option-label and traversal checks return early (`validate.ts:1096,1149,1614`); only grammar, functions, bare references and the volatile member judge. **Right**, lenient in the safe direction.
- Declared fields: `judgeFieldFormula`'s body is unchanged apart from the explicit site argument and `where ??`. **Right.**
- An extension redefining a declared field yields two sites, each authored text judged once. **Right.**
- Doors: `commands: ALL` = validate/build/lint; `os lint` exits 1 on an error. `runtimeTypes` is `flow, action, hook, object, view, page`; the object write is fenced (`objectWrite ? []`). The PR body's door claim matches the tree. **Right.**
- Location `object 'T' · <entry path> · field 'F' expression`: no consumer parses `where`; `findingKey` keys on it whole. **Right.** No export moves (`FormulaFieldSite` is not exported).

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is correct. `lint` minor + `spec` minor matches sibling narrowing changesets; the semantic entry has the five `SemanticMigration` fields; the `adr-0087: registered` id equals the entry id. `.changeset/32875-…`: every bullet holds against the diff.

DELIBERATE CORRECTION, `.changeset/32529-stored-expression-inputs.md` (unreleased):
- Before (`origin/main`): "Not yet judged: a stored computed field that an `objectExtensions` entry adds — the field-formula pass walks the fields the declared objects carry, so an expression an extension contributes is not read by either rule (a hop through a reference field an extension adds is counted)."
- After (head): "A stored computed field that an `objectExtensions` entry adds is judged by both rules too, located at the entry: the field-formula pass reads the fields an extension contributes as well as the ones the objects declare (a hop through a reference field an extension adds is counted)."
- "judged by both rules too": true (`storedExpressionInputIssues` holds both members and runs for every kept extension field). "located at the entry": true. "reads the fields an extension contributes as well as the ones the objects declare": true. The parenthetical: true, unchanged. The old sentence is false at this head. **Correction confirmed.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` vs the claim's bare `no`: correct; the arm is what `narrowed` requires.
- Out-of-scope (a) confirmed in the tree: `object_extension` appears in one `runtimeTypes` list only (`authoring-rules.ts:2499`, `validateSecurityRoleWord`) → filed by the seat as #33072.
- Out-of-scope (b) confirmed: `refuseUndeclaredHopField` and `storedMetadataBodyReferencesFor` read the target's declared fields, so a hop through an extension-added reference is not judged by those two. Lenient direction; accepted.
- PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing makes the spec's own rule real: the registry folds an extension field into the target's field map and the engine plans it like a declared one; the computed-field rules never exempted extension fields. No declared capability is removed.

No must-fix, no should-fix. Nits:
- N1 · multi-package artifact: a stored extension field hopping through both a base and an extension-added reference gets the union warning plus a second per-package warning; messages differ, so `findingKey` does not dedupe. Advisory only.
- N2 · declared target, option field tied between two packages at one priority: in `fieldIndex` but dropped from `typedObjects`, so `label(record.TIED)` in an extension formula is refused as optionless.
- N3 · tests cover neither the `packages[N].manifest.` locator, the volatile member on an extension field, nor an extension redefining a declared computed field.
- N4 · the rewritten 32529 sentence sits under "**Unchanged.**" and omits the undeclared-target limit (the 32875 changeset states it).
- Outside the diff: on `main`, the declared walk's `optionFieldNames` is declared plus injected fields while `fieldIndex` is served, so a declared formula `label(record.EXT_SELECT)` naming an extension-added select is refused as optionless. The new walk gets this right.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-14k7zk`
Reviewed-by: `subagent of session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectExtensions` 给已有对象加的存储型计算字段，现在和对象自己声明的字段一样经过公式校验（语法、函数、引用、选项标签、跨引用跳转），报错位置指向扩展条目。目标对象未声明时只做语法、函数和裸引用检查。
- 为什么改：原来扩展加进来的公式完全不检查，错的公式要到运行时才暴露；规范本来就要求计算字段一律校验。
- 风险与回滚：收紧（`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`，`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`），原来能过的错误扩展公式现在 `os validate/build/lint` 会报错；有 18 版语义迁移条目说明。lint + spec minor；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` 里扩展字段那段新循环（调用 `judgeFieldFormula`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/stored-expression-inputs.test.ts`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。`Check Changeset` 的红是按设计的（改写了未发布的 `.changeset/32529` 一句），复审记录已逐句确认。

席位意见：可以落地。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:spec#2` · head `7b18b05f` · 2026-11-13T08:12Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #32875`, draft, base `main`, 5 files, +307/−89; changesets `.changeset/32875-extension-field-formula.md` (`@objectstack/lint` + `@objectstack/spec` minor) and a rewrite of the unreleased `.changeset/32529-stored-expression-inputs.md`; new semantic entry `18.object-extension-computed-field-expression-judged`. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, matching claim 6845511887 and dev report 6847088184.
2. **Premise:** #32529 merged; on `main` the field-formula pass walks only the fields the declared objects carry, so an `objectExtensions` field's expression is read by neither rule (record 6847179102 ① reads it at head against `origin/main`).
3. **Contract review:** owed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (narrowing face; `packages/spec/src/**` non-test). Record 6847179102 on this head `7b18b05f`: PASS, no must-fix, no should-fix, nits N1–N4. Isolated subagent; the seat spot-checked the new extension loop and the 18 semantic entry at this head.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** on head `7b18b05f`: 67 runs, 1 failure, 0 running, the rest success or skipped. The one red is `Check Changeset`, red BY DESIGN on the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class (`scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` L127, L560, L1776). Confirmation: this PR changes code, so the full route applies, and the same-head at-tier PASS 6847179102 ② judges the rewritten sentence clause by clause. Before: "Not yet judged: a stored computed field that an `objectExtensions` entry adds — the field-formula pass walks the fields the declared objects carry, so an expression an extension contributes is not read by either rule (a hop through a reference field an extension adds is counted)." After: "A stored computed field that an `objectExtensions` entry adds is judged by both rules too, located at the entry: the field-formula pass reads the fields an extension contributes as well as the ones the objects declare (a hop through a reference field an extension adds is counted)." The old sentence is false at this head; correction confirmed. All three conditions to enqueue with a designed red hold. (a) The source states the red is by design on the pushed branch. (b) The job (`pr-automation.yml`) runs on `pull_request` only, not on `merge_group`. (c) This comment names the gate and the reason. K = 9 since the merge-base: under 15, no new locale pack.
5. **Accepted deviations and out-of-scope findings:**
   - The `object_extension` publish door runs no formula judgment: filed as #33072.
   - The undeclared-hop leniency on extension-added references (`refuseUndeclaredHopField`, `storedMetadataBodyReferencesFor`): lenient direction, recorded in Acceptance notes.
   - Nits N1–N4 (double warning on a multi-package artifact, a tied option field, three uncovered test shapes, the 32529 sentence under "Unchanged."): recorded in Acceptance notes.
   - Outside the diff: on `main`, a declared formula `label(record.EXT_SELECT)` is refused as optionless (record ④). Advisory only.
6. **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 33070`: NOT governed), 396 changed lines. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge under the maintainer's standing words 「车道经理应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核和落地pr」. On MERGED: #32875 closes via `Fixes`; `pm:dispatched` comes off.
